renderer: deterministic SVG topology with p5.js ambient field
primitiveBudget: one generated SVG body, twelve unequal cells, three actual apertures, four liftable topology folds, and one restrained p5.js ambient field
commitThreshold: pressure >= 0.56, opposition >= 0.62, resistance >= 0.58, and at least three turns
memoryRule: a valid pressure fold regenerates every cell and aperture and chooses a wrong pair to join from direction and fold order; four folds persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch makes a turning counterpressure path; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight moves focus; Enter/Space folds deterministically; Delete lifts; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: reciprocal Canvas ecology, proof ledger, and WEBGL vessel -> generated SVG topology with actual apertures and produced joins
compositionRupture: offset witness bands, horizontal register, and suspended object -> compact unequal cell body with no privileged target
encounterRupture: proximity notice, correction crossing, and stillness hold -> pressure argument with opposition, resistance, turns, and release
temporalRupture: global stale stare, wrong placement, and remote echo -> topology reconstructed from accumulated pressure evidence
mediumRupture: Canvas agents, proof fragments, and WebGL shell -> SVG paths and topology state with p5 ambient field only
changedRule: Only an opposed pressure gesture that turns three times can convince the naive model to change topology; release makes the whole SVG body fold around a seam that was never there.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a dark violet body of twelve angular SVG cells and three apertures. A valid release changes every cell, aperture, and seam and creates a real join between a wrong pair; four folds compound and remain liftable.
falsifier: Delete if pressure only draws a trace, weak or straight gestures commit, one cell alone changes, the join is cosmetic, order is not structural, memory resets, lifting is inexact, or the blind view reads as a generic mosaic or interface.
deletionCondition: Delete v049 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish pressure topology from v046-v048 or if the pressure rule is not visible without labels and prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
